title: A localized motive question presented with internal option codes and an untranslated metric label

question.text: 本期實況：最大單一部位 COST 佔 55%。 這次「部位 sizing」背後，主要是事先規劃、情緒反應，還是外部限制？

answers.note: #262's first two complaints, reproduced on the one engine question that carries a dimension label in its stem: the option labels were the engine's canonical codes rather than its copy, and the dimension arrived in English inside a Traditional Chinese session. The third complaint in #262 — the HTML card never reaching the screen — is a presentation-trace question (ux_receipt.py card_presented), not an answer-surface question, and no episode can grade it.
